Join Planned Observations to Saved Measurements and Select Model Rows

lexdiv_study_table.Rd

Preserve planned observations, submitted documents and measurement identities in an ordinary research table, and select one response specification with an explicit exclusion audit for statistical modelling.

Usage

lexdiv_study_table(
  planned,
  submissions,
  results,
  plan,
  condition_id,
  reporting = NULL,
  max_rows = 1e6
)

lexdiv_study_model_data(
  study,
  condition_id,
  request_id,
  required = c("writer_id", "task", "occasion")
)

# S3 method for class 'lexdiv_study_model_data'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

planned

Data frame or tibble with unique nonblank character observation_id, plus writer_id, task and occasion.

submissions

Data frame or tibble with observation_id and document_id, plus input_characters (automatically populated from preprocessing provenance if omitted when results is a lexdiv_text_batch_results object).

results

Complete result from lexdiv_metrics_batch or lexdiv_metrics_text_batch, computed with plan = plan.

plan

The explicit lexdiv_plan used for results.

condition_id

Nonblank character label for the selected analysis condition.

reporting

Optional data frame/tibble with document_id, request_id, reporting_status, and reporting_reason.

max_rows

Positive whole-number row limit.

study

Complete study table returned by lexdiv_study_table().

request_id

One request ID in the saved plan.

required

Metadata column names required to be complete for model rows.

x

A lexdiv_study_model_data object.

...

Additional arguments passed to print.data.frame().

Value

lexdiv_study_table() returns a data frame joining planned metadata, submission/input/computation/reporting states, and measurement columns. lexdiv_study_model_data() returns a lexdiv_study_model_data object with data and audit. print() displays up to 12 selected model rows and returns x invisibly.

See also

lexdiv_metrics_text_batch, lexdiv_plan

Examples

plan <- lexdiv_plan(presets = character(), specs = list(
  lexdiv_spec("ttr", request_id = "ttr")
))
planned <- data.frame(
  observation_id = c("o1", "o2"),
  writer_id = c("001", "002"),
  task = "essay",
  occasion = 1
)
submissions <- data.frame(observation_id = "o1", document_id = "d1")
results <- lexdiv_metrics_text_batch(c(d1 = "Cats chase cats."), plan = plan)
reporting <- data.frame(
  document_id = "d1", request_id = "ttr",
  reporting_status = "report", reporting_reason = "Planned specification"
)
study <- lexdiv_study_table(
  planned, submissions, results, plan, "surface-all", reporting
)
selected <- lexdiv_study_model_data(study, "surface-all", "ttr")
selected
#> <lexdiv_study_model_data: 1/2 observations included>
#>  observation_id writer_id  task occasion document_id request_id     value N
#>              o1       001 essay        1          d1        ttr 0.6666667 3
